body: Thanks for working on this! I don't think this is quite ready. There's quite a lot of inconsistencies in the new model.

No need to address these comments right away, as at least one depends on other work. I think this is mostly done, but we'll need tests and the `commit()` PR. And I guess some indication that this is indeed what everyone wants to ship.

first off, awesome work! :+1:

apologies for reviewing this as individual comments and not a cohesive review.

thank you very much in advance for your patience in reviewing my comments and answering my questions.
This also needs browser bugs. I'll try to do a final review early next week and an editorial pass.

Spec now LGTM. @annevk?

@fserb, are there web platform tests for this addition?
This is starting to look solid, thanks! Couple nits to go.

A lot of these nits are on phrasing that I introduced, so let me respond. In general it seems like a lot of them are due to arbitrary standards we haven't been enforcing previously, and which I often disagree with as they're unnecessarily verbose for no clear gain.
